purpose: Planning assumptions, not a provider quote or production capacity certificate
assumption_notes: All USD values exclude customer-collected taxes. Prices are planning snapshots checked on as_of date; no purchase or quote obtained.
Payment/FX/Billing rates are published list rates. Fee GST is assumed unrecovered for conservative cash planning; actual applicability and input credits need merchant/accountant confirmation.

Scenario feed_fixed_monthly and feed_seat_monthly are illustrative reserves, not vendor quotations or proof of a license. software_byo requires explicit valid imported/BYO data rights and excludes bundled shared feeds.

12 active users per app node is a conservative planning conversion from a local 25-user read benchmark, not real cloud/live/SQL/HA capacity. Resource budget tiers are reserves, not tested throughput or specific larger SKUs.

SQL row bytes (512 base,1024 downside), derived timeframe multiplier1.33, free space/WAL multiplier1.25, per-user history/journal, peak active fractions, egress, refunds, support, overhead and churn/CAC are assumptions, not measured physical SQL sizes. Ticks/orderbook storage is excluded; no unbounded worst-case budget is asserted.

Storage conservatively bills all estimated SQL bytes and two retained backup equivalents without subtracting included disk/storage. Additional WAL/PITR, snapshots, index/bloat and DR retention can exceed this reserve.
Hosted AI cost is zero because the configured external integration requires user-owned credentials. Company-funded AI is not included; adding it requires a separately bounded cost policy.

Cloud/node failure independence, full-node survivor traffic, connection pooling, feed recovery and regional latency have not been certified. Redis-compatible Valkey requires actual Lua/expiry/fail-closed integration tests.

5% attrition/CAC is an assumed monthly-equivalent replacement budget applied to the whole payer base, not observed monthly/annual cohort churn. First-year acquisition spend is not included in steady-state operating margins.
20% infrastructure contingency is a budget reserve, not a measured bill. Salaries/support allocations and recoverable taxes must be replaced with actual costs.
resource_budgets above 500 peak users use a fixed reserve only and are particularly speculative; all_online numbers are financial stress illustrations, not a deployable cluster design.

Current candle schema has several overlapping/composite indexes. Actual pg_total_relation_size and WAL under full imports must replace assumed row bytes before procurement. The downside can be worse with longer history, more assets, full tick/depth storage or fragmented indexes.
Dispute reserve is additional to modeled refunds, intended for non-overlapping lost dispute principal/fees; actual provider flat dispute charges are not quoted here.
